newsitem.title: UK: Burton Group shares boosted by large trade.
newsitem.headline: Burton Group shares boosted by large trade.

text.p: Shares in retailer Burton Group Plc gained ground in a weaker market on Friday, boosted by a large early trade of 7.5 million shares, dealers said.

Burton shares were 1-3/4p firmer at 155-3/4 by 1457 GMT, and were among the day's most active shares with volume of 9.6 million. Most of this volume was accounted for by the large block of 7.5 million shares which changed hands at 157p.
"We saw a big trade early on and that helped keep the price firm," one market-maker said.
